column2: you must remove a mire counter from a land that had a mire counter put on it by that instance of Cyclopean Tomb
column3: Outdated (conclusion B): this 2008-08-01 clause paraphrases the Oracle wording of the July 2008 Update Bulletin (Mark L. Gottlieb, 2008-07-09: "remove a mire counter from a land that a mire counter was put onto with Cyclopean Tomb"), replaced by the September 2008 Update Bulletin (Mark L. Gottlieb, 2008-09-24) with the current "remove all mire counters from a land that a mire counter was put onto with this artifact but that a mire counter has not been removed from with this artifact"; the engine follows the current text (interpretation cyclopean-tomb-land-choice, provisional). The rest of the ruling (each upkeep for the rest of the game; the counters' source doesn't matter) is tested in tests/cards/m_cyclopean_tomb.rs
